title: Evidence ledger entry (one line of a run's ledger)
description: One JSON line per file copied write-once (ADR-0102 §3). `prev` is the SHA-256 of the previous line's exact bytes, without its newline, or 64 zeros for the first line. The ledger's head (the SHA-256 of its last line) is kept with its write-once copy. Written and verified by scripts/python/run_evidence.py.

path.description: The file's path in the write-once copy.
